segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ?, second page's minend entry) to Mines' End. Its Lua variants run des.level_init with style "mines", string-form des.monster calls such as des.monster("gnome") through find_montype's gender draw, and the wine-cellar variant's positional des.engraving({x, y}, "engrave", text) form.
